evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce EJBench, a benchmark of engineering judgement: whether a model can predict how a design behaves at new conditions from a few earlier results, and decide on it.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Its tasks come from a conjugate heat transfer design campaign for battery cold plates, in three families: matching unlabelled test results to their operating points, choosing which stored runs to reveal before signing off a design, and ranking new duties by peak cell temperature.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: We also post-train Qwen3.5-9B with LoRA and reinforcement learning, rewarded by the share of answer criteria the simulation results confirm; on the held-out test split its score rises from 0.071 to 0.106.
